From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

The 2011 Western Bulldogs season was the club's 86th since their

Western Bulldogs

introduction to the VFL/AFL in 1925. Matthew Boyd was confirmed to be the

2011 season

captain for the season, and Rodney Eade remained as coach.
